about: La Porte County weather radio for laporteweathernow.com (Alerts page). Official NWS information read by an open-source voice (Kokoro-82M, af_heart). Replaced whenever the broadcast changes.

segments.title: Welcome
text: Good afternoon. This is the La Porte Weather Now weather radio for La Porte County, Indiana, with the latest as of 3:17 p.m., Saturday, October 17.

segments.title: Alerts
text: First, the alerts. The National Weather Service has one alert in effect for La Porte County.
There is a Frost Advisory for La Porte County from 2 a.m. Sunday until 8 a.m. Sunday.
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.
* WHERE...Portions of northern Indiana and southwest Michigan.
* WHEN...From 3 AM EDT /2 AM CDT/ to 9 AM EDT /8 AM CDT/ Sunday.
* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

segments.title: Right now
text: At 2:15 p.m., at the La Porte airport, it's 55 degrees under clear skies. The wind is at 3 mph.

segments.title: Forecast
text: Now, the forecast from the National Weather Service.
This afternoon: Sunny, with a high near 55. Southwest wind around 5 mph.
Tonight: Areas of frost after 2 a.m. Clear, with a low around 34. Southwest wind around 5 mph.
Sunday: Areas of frost before 9 a.m. Sunny, with a high near 63. Southwest wind 5 to 10 mph.
Looking further ahead. Sunday night: Clear, low around 37. Monday: Sunny, high near 66. Monday night: Mostly clear, low around 39. Tuesday: Sunny, high near 69.

segments.title: Sign-off
text: That's the latest from La Porte Weather Now. If a warning is issued, act on it right away, and keep your phone's emergency alerts turned on. Stay safe, La Porte County.
